en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, two‑storey villa or guesthouse on a sloping street with bare trees, a fence, and several people posing in front and on the hillside. Printed red text at the top right reads "Hintermauer – Meissen. Kämpfe's Heim." and along the left edge appears the publisher credit "973 Brick & Sohn, Meissen." The lower foreground is left blank for writing, in typical old postcard style.
